provenance: ChatGPT Matrix proposed a layer-wise contrast and absolute/net command difference after its first response. It declared no access to raw files. Codex froze this specific archival analysis after seeing the signed-window analysis42 and physical raw replay; no blind confirmation is claimed.
decision: Distinguish absent effective sensory contrast, loss before the exact DNb05 reader, and temporal cancellation of source-dependent command. Does not assign a synapse or validate navigation.

rivals.A: Effective input contrast is absent after encoding; falsified by a pair difference above same-layer reference/native numerical discrepancy.
rivals.B: Input differs but DNb05 reader does not; falsified by DNb05 pair difference above same-layer numerical discrepancy.
rivals.C: Reader and instantaneous command differ but the 0.0577-degree net effect hides major sign cancellation; falsified by an absolute/net ratio close to one. No threshold is selected from this exposed trace.

metrics: For each field/window: paired plus-minus RMS and max absolute difference, same-arm native-vs-reference maximum RMS and max absolute discrepancy. Do not compare RMS magnitudes across units. For command across all400ms: absolute integral of paired instantaneous difference, signed integral, net/absolute ratio, and positive/negative/zero sample counts.
controls: Both strict-reference and native traces are already exposed. Check SHA256, phase, clock, shapes, finite values and baseline/decoder, but do not use 400 temporal samples as independent seeds. Prepared sham is a pair baseline, not a pure numerical-noise estimate.
stop: One fixed layer profile. No scale fitting, reader fitting, threshold promotion, neural rerun or posthoc field selection.
